body.name: Skeptical certificate checker
body.construction: \(Check(S,G,Rsrc,Psrc,rho,a,B,Ictx,K,F,Z,Gamma)\) first recomputes the injective canonical digest and rejects any mismatch. It then verifies the schema and graph references, the exhaustive lexicographic indexing of source nodes and event-consistent target assignments in \(Ictx\), acyclicity and target relevance, the exact positive parent-context cells used to recover \(K\), and the unique unsupported key \(rstar\). It replays the target truncated factorization gate by gate and requires its dense coefficient list to equal \(F\). It next checks square-free data, Sturm root counts, resultant membership, Sturm--Tarski signs, candidate exhaustiveness, value ordering, tie labels, and algebraic threshold order. Finally it decodes both groundings in \(Z\), verifies type sharing, nonnegative finite-noise masses, independent node copies, mechanism outputs, exact reproduction of every source table in \(Psrc\), and exact target values \(L\) and \(U\); it returns one exactly when every clause succeeds.
